texture_overrides_note: Supabase commits to a white marketing canvas, but its developer DNA lives on the canvas-night #1c1c1c surface it uses for code blocks, the featured pricing tier, and card-feature-dark. The tribute uses that dark variant so the single emerald event (#3ecf8e, 8.54:1 on canvas, clears the 4.5 floor) glows for the WOW halation gate and the RECEIPT hero numerals carry weight. Inter at weight 600 with -0.02 tracking substitutes for the proprietary Circular per the brand's own font note (it caps marketing display at 500; nudged to 600 only for motion legibility of huge numerals). White ink is 17.04:1 and the #9a9a9a muted ladder is 6.06:1, both comfortable. Emerald is scarce by brand rule: it accents the two big_number numerals and the close line only, nowhere else. halation 0.08 blooms that green; lighting_arc 0.26 gives RECEIPT its color drift; grain 0.05 plus vignette 0.20 hold the quiet-technical atmosphere.
